dispatch: Session 303 closed the vault's premium audit: 11 of 15 fixes shipped, including a theme boot flaw silent since multi-theme first shipped, caught by the new CANON-047 image-test and propagated across 113 pages. The forge also sealed /proof, letting visitors re-verify the deploy ledger's hash chain themselves, while /status shed a false incident and /atlas gained its constellation map. One fix stays founder-gated, dossier in hand, awaiting the production Worker deploy.
